descriptor: Dense oval shade tree; opposite palmate leaves with rounded sinuses; brilliant yellow-orange-red fall; grey shaggy-plated bark.
identityNotes: Rounded (U-shaped) leaf sinuses with few large teeth and a green (not silver) underside separate it from silver/red maple. Classic mixed yellow-orange-red autumn, often all on one tree.

referenceImages.caption: Full oval crown in leaf; rounded-sinus palmate leaves visible.

referenceImages.caption: Mixed yellow-orange-red autumn canopy, the classic sugar-maple display.
Mature grey plated/shaggy bark with vertical lifting strips.
